title: The website's machine section prints legibly
outcome: The website's machine section prints legibly
acceptance: Folios V to VIII print as dark text on white with their commands and step lists readable and no text overlapping, from a fresh load and from a deep link, with background graphics on and off, on A4 and on narrow paper
The print rules are few and hide decoration by one rule per kind; no print rule repeats a value taken from a screen animation; the screen is unchanged and the human folios print as before
